findings: formal_gate_overlap_observer_v0_2 is not exact for valuation: when relative PE>2.5, revenueQuarterYoY<=25 and epsYoY is null, deployed JavaScript evaluates null>25 as false and rejects, while v0.2 marks the gate UNKNOWN.
Missing epsYoY is therefore an evidence-quality caveat but not a deployed decision UNKNOWN. Future research must separate exact Formal result from exception-evidence completeness.
sectorMedianPe is computed from all positive-PE featureRows in the industry and includes the candidate itself when its PE is positive.
The current minimum length>=3 therefore means positive-PE constituent count, not leave-one-out peer count.

Fixed counterexample [10,40,100]: deployed inclusive median=40, candidate PE 100 has ratio exactly 2.5 and is not rejected; leave-one-out median=25 would yield ratio 4.0 and reject. The leave-one-out value is not deployed truth and must not replace the captured sectorMedianPe.

PR #112 V8.15 valuation provenance is stale relative to current main and recomputes a sector median from an older sector object rather than freezing the deployed feature.sectorMedianPe; it must not be treated as current promotion-grade semantics.
denominatorRules: Formal-reach population must positively clear every earlier ordered gate through ANNOUNCEMENT_RISK.
Official/observed PE<=0 or canonical PE N/A is NOT_APPLICABLE to the relative-PE veto, not cheap valuation.
Positive PE with sectorMedianPe unavailable is research UNKNOWN even though deployed Formal skips the veto.
High relative PE with revenue growth<=25 and epsYoY missing is a deployed FAIL with incomplete EPS-exception evidence, not UNKNOWN.
Do not recompute historical sectorMedianPe from current classifications or current valuation data.
